_about: Public-domain Bernard of Clairvaux (1090-1153, Cistercian abbot) in English for the Word Hoard: Samuel J. Eales's Life and Works (4 vols, 1889-1896, the letters and the sermons on the Song of Songs) and Gasquet's selection of the letters from CCEL, the Life of St. Malachy (Lawlor, 1920) from Project Gutenberg, and On Loving God (Patmore 1881; van Allen 1909), On Consideration (Lewis 1908), Grace and Free Will (Williams 1920), The Twelve Degrees of Humility and Pride (Mills 1929) and the Advent and Christmas sermons from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 25 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

bernard-letters-gasquet: Some Letters of Saint Bernard, Abbot of Clairvaux, from the translation of Samuel J. Eales, selected with a preface by F. A. Gasquet (London: John Hodges, 1904)

bernard-life-of-malachy: St. Bernard of Clairvaux's Life of St. Malachy of Armagh, by H. J. Lawlor (London: SPCK, 1920)

bernard-life-works-eales-4: Life and Works of Saint Bernard, vol. IV: Cantica Canticorum, Eighty-six Sermons on the Song of Solomon, tr. Samuel J. Eales (London: John Hodges, 1896)
